data.title: This Palm-Sized Robot Dog Is Built With Zero Wires Inside
data.description: A California startup called ZeroWire Robotics is about to launch Q8botOne — a palm-sized quadruped robot with a radical trick: it has no wires or cable harnesses inside at all. Every component, from its eight programmable Dynamixel actuators to its ESP32 brain and rechargeable battery, mounts directly onto one central circuit board.
data.author: Interesting Engineering
